name: Rambagh Palace (Taj Hotels)
description: Former royal residence of the Maharaja of Jaipur, now a 5-star heritage hotel with palatial suites, polo grounds, and award-winning restaurants.

name: Samode Haveli
description: Beautifully restored 175-year-old haveli with hand-painted frescoes, courtyard pool, and authentic Rajasthani hospitality.

name: Bani Park Boutique Hotel
description: Comfortable mid-range hotel in the quiet Bani Park neighbourhood, 10 min from Hawa Mahal. Good breakfast and rooftop views.

name: Zostel Jaipur
description: Popular backpacker hostel near Hathroi Fort with dorms and private rooms, rooftop cafe, and social events.

name: Hotel Pearl Palace
description: Award-winning budget hotel with rooftop restaurant, free Wi-Fi, and helpful staff. Consistently rated best budget stay in Jaipur.

name: Taj Exotica Resort & Spa
description: Sprawling 5-star beachfront resort on Benaulim Beach with private beach, multiple pools, spa, and 5 restaurants.

name: W Goa
description: Trendy 5-star resort on Vagator cliffs with infinity pool, beach club, and vibrant nightlife scene.

name: Alila Diwa Goa
description: Boutique resort with rice paddy views, infinity pool, and authentic Goan cuisine. Peaceful South Goa location.

name: Panjim Inn Heritage Hotel
description: Charming heritage hotel in Goa's Latin Quarter with Portuguese-era architecture, antique furniture, and courtyard garden.

name: Zostel Goa
description: Lively hostel near Baga Beach with dorms, private rooms, beach access, and social events.

name: Span Resort & Spa
description: Luxury riverside resort on the Beas River with mountain views, spa, heated pool, and adventure activities.

name: The Himalayan Hotel
description: Well-established hotel on Mall Road with mountain views, restaurant, and easy access to all attractions.

name: Snow Valley Resorts
description: Cozy resort in Old Manali with wooden interiors, mountain views, and proximity to cafes and trekking trails.

name: Zostel Manali
description: Popular hostel in Old Manali with mountain views, bonfire evenings, and easy access to trekking routes.

name: Brunton Boatyard (CGH Earth)
description: Heritage hotel in a restored 19th-century boatyard with harbour views, infinity pool, and award-winning Kerala cuisine.

name: Old Harbour Hotel
description: Boutique hotel in a 300-year-old Dutch-era building with courtyard pool, antique decor, and walking distance to Chinese fishing nets.

name: Malabar House
description: Award-winning boutique hotel in a restored 18th-century Portuguese mansion with contemporary art and fusion restaurant.

name: Zostel Kochi
description: Centrally located hostel in Fort Kochi with dorms and private rooms, walking distance to all heritage sites.

name: The Leela Palace New Delhi
description: Ultra-luxury 5-star palace hotel with butler service, rooftop pool, and Michelin-starred dining. Consistently rated India's best hotel.

name: The Claridges New Delhi
description: Historic 5-star hotel built in 1952 with colonial architecture, lush gardens, and central location near India Gate.

name: Bloomrooms @ New Delhi Railway Station
description: Modern design hotel near New Delhi Railway Station with clean rooms, good breakfast, and easy metro access.

name: Zostel Delhi
description: Well-located hostel in Paharganj with dorms and private rooms, rooftop cafe, and easy access to metro and railway station.

name: The Oberoi Amarvilas
description: World's best hotel with Taj Mahal views from every room. Moorish architecture, infinity pool, and butler service. 600m from the Taj.

name: Trident Agra
description: 5-star hotel with Mughal-inspired architecture, large pool, and excellent location between Taj Mahal and Agra Fort.

name: Hotel Kamal
description: Budget guesthouse 200m from Taj Mahal South Gate with rooftop restaurant offering Taj views. Clean rooms and helpful staff.

name: Wildflower Hall (Oberoi)
description: Former residence of Lord Kitchener at 8,250 ft. Cedar forest setting, heated pool, spa, and panoramic Himalayan views.

name: Hotel Combermere
description: Heritage hotel on Mall Road built in 1884, walking distance to Ridge and Christ Church. Colonial architecture with modern amenities.

name: Radisson Hotel Shimla
description: Modern 4-star hotel with valley views, indoor heated pool, spa, and multiple dining options.

name: Zostel Shimla
description: Cozy hostel near Lakkar Bazaar with mountain views, bonfire area, and easy access to Mall Road.

name: Aloha on the Ganges
description: Luxury tented resort on the Ganges with private beach, yoga pavilion, spa, and adventure activities.

name: Atali Ganga
description: Riverside eco-resort with rafting access, yoga classes, organic meals, and stunning Ganges views.

name: Zostel Rishikesh
description: Popular hostel near Ram Jhula with Ganges views, yoga sessions, and easy access to rafting and trekking.

name: The Taj Mahal Palace Hotel
description: India's most iconic hotel (1903) overlooking Gateway of India. Heritage wing with original Tata-era rooms, 10 restaurants, and legendary service.

name: Trident Nariman Point
description: 5-star hotel on Marine Drive with sea views, rooftop pool, and central business district location.

name: Zostel Mumbai
description: Well-located hostel in Colaba near Gateway of India with dorms and private rooms, social events, and city tours.

name: The Leela Palace Bengaluru
description: Palatial 5-star hotel with Dravidian architecture, 9 restaurants, rooftop pool, and award-winning spa.

name: Taj MG Road Bengaluru
description: 5-star hotel on MG Road with rooftop pool, multiple restaurants, and walking distance to Brigade Road shopping.

name: Zostel Bangalore
description: Trendy hostel in Koramangala with dorms and private rooms, co-working space, and easy access to Bengaluru's startup scene.
